title: O2O catalog CSV feed parameters
content_data:
The following table lists the parameters you can configure for an online-to-offline (O2O) catalog when passing a CSV file to the `file_url` parameter in [/catalog/product/file/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-file-url/v1.3). ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |listing_id {Required}|string|A unique ID for the listing.

No length limit.| |title {Required}|string|The name of the listing.

Recommended length: 25 characters.

Example: `Big Mac`| |description {Required}|string|The description of the listing.

Length limit: 5,000 characters.

Recommended length: 40 characters.

Example: `Nice burger!`| |availability {Required}|string|The current availability status of the listing.

Enum values:
  • `in stock`
  • `available for order`
  • `preorder`
  • `out of stock`
  • `discontinued`
| |image_link {Required}|string|The main image URL for the listing.

Requirements:
  • The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`.
  • The image must be in JPG, JPEG, or PNG format.
  • The image must be at least 500 × 500 pixels and no larger than 1290 × 2790 pixels.
  • The URL must link directly to the image file.

Example: `https://www.tiktok.com/tiktok_service_001.jpg`.| |link|string|The web landing page URL for the listing.

The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`.

If you want to specify app deeplinks, use the `ios_url` or `android_url` parameter instead.

Example: `https://www.tiktok.com/tiktok_service`| |brand|string|The brand name of the listing.

Length limit: 150 characters.| |product_type|string|The category that the listing (product or service) belongs to.

Example: `Thai food`.| |rating|double|The user rating for the listing.

Value range: 0.0-5.0.| |condition|string|The current condition of the listing.

Enum values:
  • `new`
  • `refurbished`
  • `used`
| |price|double|The price of one listed item.

The catalog target country’s default currency will be used.

Ensure that the price matches the price on the landing page and checkout page.

Example: 9.99.| |google_product_category|string|A preset category from Google's product taxonomy.

This field supports up to three levels.

Learn more about [Google product category](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324436).

Example: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Dresses| |item_group_id|string|The SPU ID shared by all variants of a specific product.

Items that are variants of a specific product. Provide the same `item_group_id` for all items that are variants. For example, a spicy Chicken Burger is a variant of Chicken Burger.

Example: `TikTok_1234`.| |additional_image_link|string|A list of additional image URLs for the listing.

Requirements:
  • The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`.
  • The image must be in JPG, JPEG, or PNG format.
  • The image must be at least 500 × 500 pixels and no larger than 1290 × 2790 pixels.
  • The URL must link directly to the image file.
  • Separate multiple URLs with commas.

Up to 20 links are allowed.

Example:`https://www.tiktok.com/tiktok_service_002.jpg`| |color|string|The color of the listing.

Example: `blue`.| |size|string|The size of the listed item.

Example: `small`.| |material|string|The main material of the listed item.

Example: `cotton`.| |pattern|string|The pattern or graphic print on the listed item.

Example: `stripes1`.| |sale_price|double|The discounted price of one listed item.

The catalog target country’s default currency will be used.

Ensure that the discounted price matches the discounted price on the landing page and checkout page.

Example: 4.99| |sale_price_effective_date|string|The effective date and time range for the discounted price, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM+00:00/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM+00:00` (UTC time).

Use a start date before the end date.

Example: `2026-12-11T23:59+00:00/2026-12-15T23:59+00:00`.| |gtin|string|The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for the listed item.

Specify a value of 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits.

Example: 323456789012.| |tax|string|The tax rate for the listed item.

The catalog target country’s default currency will be used.| |age_group|string|The intended age group for the listing.

Enum values:
  • `newborn`
  • `infant`
  • `toddler`
  • `kids`
  • `adult`
| |gender|string|The intended gender for the listing.

Enum values:
  • `male`
  • `female`
  • `unisex`
| |availability_circle_radius|string|The radius from the origin where the item can be fulfilled. This defines a circular availability area.

Value range:
  • When the unit is kilometer: greater than 0 and ≤ 40.
  • When the unit is mile: greater than 0 and ≤ 25.

Example: 20.| |availability_circle_radius_unit|string|The unit for `availability_circle_radius`.

Enum values:
  • `km`: kilometer.
  • `mi`: mile.
| |address_street|string|The street address where the product or service is located.

Length limit: 150 characters.

Example: `1143 coleman Avenue`.| |address_city|string|The city where the product or service is located.

Length limit: 150 characters.

Example: `San Jose`.| |address_region|string|The state, province, or administrative region where the product or service is located.

Length limit: 150 characters.

Example: `California`.| |address_postal_code|string|The postal or ZIP code of the product or service location.

Length limit: 150 characters.

Example: `95050`.| |address_latitude|double|The latitude of the product or service location.

Value range: [-90, 90].

Example: -25.5.| |address_longitude|double|The longitude of the product or service location.

Value range: [-180, 180].

Example: 100.5.| |ios_url|string|The iOS app URL for the listed item.

Example: `iOS://electronic`.| |ios_app_store_id|string|The App Store ID of the iOS app.| |ios_app_name|string|The name of the iOS app.| |android_url|string|The Android app URL for the listed item.

Example: `android://electronic`.| |android_package|string|The Android package name.| |android_app_name|string|The Android app name.| |custom_label_0|string|A custom label used to add information about the listing.| |custom_label_1|string|A custom label used to add information about the listing.| |custom_label_2|string|A custom label used to add information about the listing.| |custom_label_3|string|A custom label used to add information about the listing.| |custom_label_4|string|A custom label used to add information about the listing.| |custom_number_0|double|A custom numeric attribute for product management.| |custom_number_1|double|A custom numeric attribute for product management.| |custom_number_2|double|A custom numeric attribute for product management.| |custom_number_3|double|A custom numeric attribute for product management.| |custom_number_4|double|A custom numeric attribute for product management.| ```
